reviews.label: C01
reviews.strength: Clearly lays out the kit, listed price, prepaid savings, support and purchase terms across useful angles.
reviews.priority_fix: Make the kit’s practical relevance more explicit, and trim the repeated adult-supervision qualification where it competes with the offer.

reviews.label: C02
reviews.strength: Addresses installation hesitation directly and uses the available one-to-one video-support claim without promising an easy or quick setup.
reviews.priority_fix: Give the three variants more distinct executions; all return to the same installation-support message and repeat the kit inventory.

reviews.label: C03
reviews.strength: Connects installation uncertainty to guided support and includes relevant product details and offer information.
reviews.priority_fix: Reduce the repeated component lists and avoid loading installation-focused ads with price and savings unless those details are a deliberate variant angle.

reviews.label: C04
reviews.strength: The first variant gives a relatable home-preparation moment; the others provide concrete product, support and purchase-policy details.
reviews.priority_fix: Replace general phrases such as “practical childproofing” with a clearer explanation of what the listed measures address, and tighten the repeated safety qualifications.

reviews.label: C05
reviews.strength: Provides straightforward reassurance through the kit contents, installation support and stated purchase policies without claiming a home becomes child-safe.
reviews.priority_fix: Make the benefits more shopper-specific and shorten the long inventory sentences, especially in the installation and policy variants.

reviews.label: C06
reviews.strength: Recognises uncertainty about getting started and makes the available installation guidance easy to find.
reviews.priority_fix: Replace “six childproofing items” with “six-part kit” to avoid suggesting an unverified count of individual pieces; also vary the three closely related angles.

issues.quote: The Peach Bucket brings six childproofing items together
issues.reason: The supplied facts support a six-part or 6-in-1 kit, but “six items” may be read as a verified count of individual pieces.

reviews.label: C07
reviews.strength: Strong product-aware framing: it makes the listed price clear and separates kit contents, setup support and guarantees into distinct angles.
reviews.priority_fix: Make one variant explain the practical relevance of the kit rather than relying mainly on the inventory and offer details.

reviews.label: C08
reviews.strength: Balances product details and support with practical reassurance, while keeping the adult-supervision qualification appropriately clear.
reviews.priority_fix: Make the variants more different from one another and replace broad claims like “more practical” with a specific shopper benefit.

reviews.label: C09
reviews.strength: Presents the listed price, prepaid savings, kit contents and available support and guarantees clearly.
reviews.priority_fix: Stop repeating the full kit inventory and every offer element in all three variants; choose one main angle per ad and shorten the copy.
